data.name: Hotel Riu Plaza Panama
data.address: XFJH+HF5, C. 50, Panamá, Provincia de Panamá, Panama
data.description:
Bordering the Obarrio financial district, this ultramodern, high-rise hotel is a 3-minute walk from the World Trade Center Panama and a 10-minute walk from Iglesia del Carmen metro station.
Chic rooms come with sitting areas, free Wi-Fi and flat-screens, as well as minifridges, coffeemakers and desks. Upgraded rooms add minibars and city views. Suites feature living rooms; some have kitchenettes. Room service is provided 24/7.
A breakfast buffet is free. Amenities include a laid-back restaurant and a sushi eatery, along with 2 bars and a 24-hour deli. There are also meeting/event rooms, plus a spa, an outdoor pool and a gym. Parking is available for a fee.
